landing.heroSubtitle: Visually orchestrate LLM workflows with step debugging, variable monitoring and one-click Agent publishing — a developer-first AI automation platform.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From orchestration and debugging to production runs — the full AI workflow lifecycle
landing.feature1Desc: Drag-and-drop free-form canvas with intuitive node wiring, free layout and alignment snapping.
landing.feature2Desc: Built-in LLM, intent classification and JSON extraction nodes that compose seamlessly with code and HTTP nodes.
landing.feature3Desc: Breakpoints, step execution, variable monitoring and mock testing — debug workflows like code.
landing.feature4Desc: Publish any workflow as an Agent with one click and invoke it directly from the chat interface.
landing.feature5Desc: Webhook and cron triggers with HMAC signatures and built-in rate limiting.
landing.feature6Desc: Centrally manage OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen and more — switch models freely.
landing.bottomTitle: Ready to build your AI workflows?
landing.bottomSubtitle: Go from orchestration to production in minutes, with every AI call stable and traceable.
landing.howSubtitle: Four steps from idea to production automation
landing.step1Desc: Drag nodes and wire them into flows — LLM, code, HTTP and conditional branches compose freely.
landing.step2Desc: Breakpoints, stepping and live variable monitoring pinpoint issues in complex flows.
landing.step3Desc: Webhook and cron triggers run flows automatically, with HMAC signatures and rate limiting.
landing.step4Desc: Publish workflows as Agents with one click — invoke them in chat or integrate anywhere.
landing.debugSubtitle: An industry-first debugging experience: breakpoints, stepping, variable monitoring and mock testing — no more black-box runs.
landing.debugPoint1: Conditional breakpoints that pause on hit
landing.debugPoint2: Live variable watch for every node's input and output
landing.debugPoint3: Mock data testing without external dependencies
landing.devSubtitle: Everything is API-first: trigger workflows via webhook, import and export them as JSON, and integrate with your existing systems.
landing.devDesc1: REST API + WebSocket real-time event stream
landing.devDesc2: One-click JSON import/export — versionable and portable
landing.devDesc3: SQLite zero-config deployment, ready out of the box

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.hint: Triggers run a workflow without you pressing Run: a webhook gives you a URL any external system can POST to, and a schedule fires on a cron expression. Triggered runs land in the same execution history.
triggers.noWebhook: No webhook yet. Create one to get a callable URL.
triggers.noCron: No schedule yet. Enter a cron expression and create one.
triggers.webhookHint: POST to this URL and the JSON body becomes the workflow input. GET also works, with the query string as input. The URL itself is the credential -- keep it secret.
triggers.cronHint: Format: minute hour day month weekday (server local time, one-minute resolution). Aliases like @hourly / @daily / @weekly are also accepted.
triggers.rotateConfirm: Rotating invalidates the current URL immediately. Continue?
triggers.secretHint: Sign each request with X-ZCL-Flow-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, raw body). Copy it now -- it is never shown again.
triggers.signatureHint: Send X-ZCL-Flow-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, raw body). Unsigned or tampered calls are rejected with 401.
